queries.source_title: Delivering on the Clean Industrial Deal I
queries.proposition: The Commission reports active EU mechanisms around industrial decarbonisation, including counter-guarantees for clean-energy PPAs, an industrial process-heat auction, grid and flexibility measures, priority sustainability requirements for steel and aluminium, and public monitoring of metal scrap flows.
queries.status: Supported as a current policy and market-structure signal; customer willingness to pay for any proposed service is unknown.
queries.contradiction: The same communication emphasizes simplification and reduced administrative burden, so compliance-heavy intermediaries could be designed out; several measures were still proposed or under consultation rather than final operating programs.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Show one-page paid offers to three metal firms, three industrial heat users, and three renewable developers, and ask each for a conditional letter of intent tied to a named live transaction.

queries.search_text: site:digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu Data Act applies 12 September 2025 connected products user access data official EU
queries.source_title: EU Data Act gives users control over data from connected devices
queries.proposition: The EU Data Act applies and gives consumers and businesses access to and sharing rights over raw data from connected products, explicitly including cars and industrial machinery and pointing to repair, maintenance, manufacturing, and agriculture uses.
queries.status: Supported as a legal access mechanism; data quality, delivery friction, permitted fields, and buyer budgets remain unknown by device category.
queries.contradiction: A legal right to raw data does not guarantee standardized interfaces, low integration cost, complete historical data, freedom from trade-secret or privacy limits, or economically useful signal quality.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: With one consenting owner in each target category, request export or third-party delivery from three equipment brands and attempt one decision-grade report before building software.

concepts.title: Assayed Scrap Offtake Exchange
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Own the transaction layer for regional metal scrap by attaching independent composition evidence to each lot and charging when a foundry accepts an otherwise discounted or rejected load.
concepts.customer: Small foundries and metal recyclers trading inconsistent aluminium and steel scrap
concepts.loss_event: A lot is rejected, downgraded, or hauled twice because composition and contamination are not trusted before delivery.
concepts.payer: The seller through a closing fee, optionally shared with the buyer
concepts.authority_holder: The scrap owner authorizing sampling and sale
concepts.distributor: Mobile assay operators, scrapyards, and foundry purchasing managers
concepts.risk_bearer: Independent laboratory for assay accuracy and the seller for undisclosed contamination
concepts.transaction_owner: A marketplace that standardizes lot evidence, bids, acceptance terms, and settlement
concepts.first_paid_event: A foundry accepts and settles a lot introduced with the standardized assay packet.
concepts.acquisition_route: Start with one mobile assay partner and phone-based sourcing from scrapyards within a single foundry catchment.
concepts.compounding_asset: A proprietary dataset linking origin, assay, contamination, accepted price, and buyer outcome by scrap category
hypotheses: Pre-delivery evidence changes acceptance or pricing enough to fund a transaction fee.
Sellers will permit representative sampling before bids.
A narrow regional lane can supply repeat transaction density.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No reliance on mislabeling waste, concealing contamination, or bypassing waste-shipment and materials rules.

concepts.title: Process-Heat Auction Bid Factory
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Convert wasteful industrial heat projects into submission-ready electrification or renewable-heat bids and collect a staged fee plus success fee only when financing closes.
concepts.customer: Medium-sized factories with gas-fired process heat and no internal project-finance team
concepts.loss_event: A viable heat conversion misses funding or stalls because metering, baseline, vendor design, and bid evidence are fragmented.
concepts.payer: The factory or selected equipment developer
concepts.beneficiary: Factory owner, project developer, and financing provider
concepts.authority_holder: Factory management controlling meter access and capital approval
concepts.distributor: Boiler service firms, energy auditors, and regional industry associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Factory for operating assumptions, vendor for performance guarantees, and funder for award decisions
concepts.transaction_owner: A bid-packaging desk controlling the baseline model, evidence room, vendor competition, and financing handoff
concepts.first_paid_event: A factory pays for a metered feasibility packet, with the larger fee triggered by financing close.
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer a fixed-scope screening through heat-equipment service partners that already see fuel bills and replacement cycles.
concepts.compounding_asset: Reusable process-heat baselines, vendor cost curves, award objections, and measured post-conversion performance
hypotheses: Factories have candidate projects that fail at evidence assembly rather than technical feasibility.
A staged fee is acceptable before any uncertain public award.
Vendors will provide data under a standardized competitive template.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No promise of grant approval, privileged access, or manipulation of emissions baselines.

concepts.title: Subscale PPA Guarantee Origination Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Bundle smaller industrial electricity buyers into financeable clean-power contracts and get paid at close for assembling credit evidence, generation supply, and guarantee-provider handoff.
concepts.customer: Mid-sized factories seeking stable electricity prices and renewable developers with projects too small for bespoke origination
concepts.loss_event: A power contract fails because buyer credit, volume shape, legal work, and guarantee eligibility are uneconomic to assemble one counterparty at a time.
concepts.payer: Developer and industrial buyer through disclosed closing fees
concepts.beneficiary: Electricity buyer, project developer, and financing bank
concepts.authority_holder: Buyer CFOs and developer investment committees
concepts.distributor: Energy brokers, renewable installers, banks, and industrial accountants
concepts.risk_bearer: Contract counterparties and any independent guarantee provider, not the origination desk
concepts.transaction_owner: An arranger controlling cohort formation, term-sheet standardization, diligence room, and introductions
concepts.first_paid_event: A bundled buyer cohort signs a bankable term sheet and pays the agreed origination milestone.
concepts.acquisition_route: Recruit factories through energy-cost reviews and match only buyers with compatible load shape and contracting horizon.
concepts.compounding_asset: A private map of buyer credit readiness, interval-load shapes, developer terms, and deal failure reasons
hypotheses: Guarantee channels accept aggregated mid-market structures.
Buyers will share interval and credit data before a binding quote.
Standardized terms reduce legal and origination cost enough to create a fee pool.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No holding of client funds, unlicensed credit intermediation, or claim that an EU or EIB guarantee is assured.

concepts.title: Grid-Constraint-First Site Rights
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Option land only after a data-led grid and permitting screen, then sell development rights to renewable or storage developers when a site clears a defined diligence gate.
concepts.customer: Renewable and battery developers wasting origination spend on sites that cannot connect economically
concepts.loss_event: Months of land and permit work are lost when grid constraints make a site unfinanceable.
concepts.payer: Developer acquiring an optioned, screened site
concepts.authority_holder: Landowner for site rights and grid operator or authorities for connection and permits
concepts.distributor: Regional installers, land agents, and electrical engineering firms
concepts.risk_bearer: The site-rights vehicle for option costs and the acquirer after the stated diligence gate
concepts.transaction_owner: A special-purpose site originator holding assignable land options and the diligence record
concepts.first_paid_event: A developer pays an option assignment fee after reviewing a pre-agreed evidence packet.
concepts.acquisition_route: Use the family renewable-installation network to source landowners and validate one narrow distribution-grid region.
concepts.compounding_asset: Parcel-level grid, permit, landowner, rejection, and developer-demand intelligence
hypotheses: Public and partner data predict fatal connection issues before formal application.
Landowners accept low-cost conditional options.
Developers pay for reduced early-stage failure risk rather than sourcing sites themselves.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No claim that a screening result constitutes a grid-connection promise or permit approval.

concepts.title: Metal Tender Evidence Utility
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Give small metal fabricators a supplier-backed sustainability evidence packet per tender and charge only when the packet is accepted as complete by the buyer.
concepts.customer: Steel and aluminium fabricators selling into larger EU supply chains
concepts.loss_event: A supplier loses or delays a tender because material origin, recycled content, emissions, or supporting documents cannot be reconciled quickly.
concepts.authority_holder: Fabricator management and upstream mills controlling source documents
concepts.distributor: Tender consultants, industry associations, accountants, and metal distributors
concepts.risk_bearer: Document issuer for source accuracy and fabricator for representations in the tender
concepts.transaction_owner: An evidence utility controlling document requests, normalization, exception handling, and buyer-ready export
concepts.first_paid_event: The buyer's procurement team accepts a tender evidence packet as complete.
concepts.acquisition_route: Manually assemble one live tender packet for a Polish exporter before automating repeated supplier requests.
concepts.compounding_asset: A permissioned graph of suppliers, document types, accepted mappings, expiry patterns, and procurement objections
hypotheses: Missing evidence is a recurring tender loss rather than a rare enterprise request.
Upstream suppliers will release verifiable documents to an authorized fabricator.
Buyer acceptance can be defined clearly enough to trigger payment.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No fabricated sustainability claims, inferred certifications, or presentation of estimates as supplier-verified facts.

concepts.title: Machine-Data Maintenance Tender Agent
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Use factory-authorized machine data to run competitive maintenance tenders and earn a share of verified savings or avoided service scope.
concepts.customer: Factories locked into expensive original-equipment maintenance despite having connected machinery
concepts.loss_event: The plant accepts unnecessary replacement, opaque service scope, or avoidable downtime because independent maintainers lack usable operating evidence.
concepts.payer: Factory owner from realized maintenance savings
concepts.beneficiary: Factory owner and qualified independent maintainer
concepts.authority_holder: The factory as connected-product user and maintenance decision maker
concepts.distributor: Independent maintenance firms, plant insurers, and industrial energy auditors
concepts.risk_bearer: Maintenance provider for workmanship and factory for operating decisions unless separately insured
concepts.transaction_owner: A neutral tender agent controlling authorized data intake, fault brief, bids, and savings reconciliation
concepts.first_paid_event: An independently priced maintenance job closes and produces contractually defined savings against the comparable incumbent quote.
concepts.acquisition_route: Begin with one machine family where a maintenance partner can interpret raw sensor exports manually.
concepts.compounding_asset: Cross-brand mappings from raw signals to faults, bid scopes, repairs, downtime, and realized outcomes
hypotheses: Factories can obtain timely raw data in a form an independent expert can use.
Independent bids remain valid without restricted diagnostic tooling.
Savings can be measured without encouraging deferred necessary maintenance.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No unauthorized access, circumvention of device security, or use of employee-level telemetry without a lawful basis.

concepts.title: Farmer-Owned Equipment Benchmark Cooperative
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Pool farmer-authorized machinery data into field-level operating benchmarks, selling agronomy decisions to members and only de-identified aggregate insight to suppliers under cooperative control.
concepts.customer: Independent farms using connected tractors, implements, or harvesters across multiple brands
concepts.loss_event: Fuel, passes, machine settings, and input timing remain inefficient because each farm sees only vendor-specific fragments and no comparable peer baseline.
concepts.payer: Farm members for decision support, with optional licensed aggregate reports purchased by input or equipment suppliers
concepts.authority_holder: Each farmer for contributed machine data and the cooperative board for aggregate licensing
concepts.distributor: Agronomists, machinery service shops, farm accountants, and producer groups
concepts.risk_bearer: Farmers for operational choices and the cooperative for privacy, aggregation, and contract compliance
concepts.transaction_owner: A farmer-controlled cooperative that sets permissions, benchmark rules, and licensing terms
concepts.first_paid_event: A farm pays for a season-specific benchmark report built from its own export plus a qualifying peer cohort.
concepts.acquisition_route: Recruit one crop-and-machine cohort through an agronomist and deliver spreadsheets before building connectors.
concepts.compounding_asset: A consented longitudinal dataset joining machine settings, field conditions, interventions, and farm-reported outcomes
hypotheses: Exports contain comparable variables across enough machinery brands.
Farmers value peer benchmarks while retaining governance rights.
A cohort can be aggregated without revealing commercially sensitive farm performance.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No sale of identifiable farm data, coercive consent, or repurposing beyond member-approved terms.

concepts.title: Heat-Pump Performance Warranty Rail
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Turn owner-authorized heat-pump telemetry into an installer performance certificate and warranty trigger that lets strong installers sell guaranteed comfort and efficiency.
concepts.customer: Heat-pump installers whose good work is hard to distinguish and building owners exposed to underperformance disputes
concepts.loss_event: The owner pays high energy bills or lacks comfort while installer, equipment maker, and building conditions each receive blame without shared evidence.
concepts.payer: Installer per commissioned system, potentially passed through in the installation price
concepts.authority_holder: Building owner for device data and installer or warranty provider for remediation approval
concepts.distributor: Renewable installers, building-energy auditors, lenders, and home insurers
concepts.risk_bearer: Installer or licensed warranty or insurance partner under explicit coverage terms
concepts.transaction_owner: A measurement rail controlling baseline, commissioning record, telemetry checks, exception evidence, and claim routing
concepts.first_paid_event: An installer buys the first post-commissioning performance certificate for a customer system.
concepts.acquisition_route: Pilot on installations from the family renewable firm using owner consent and manual exports from one heat-pump brand.
concepts.compounding_asset: A labeled dataset of building conditions, commissioning settings, weather-normalized performance, faults, and remedies
hypotheses: Owner-accessible data is sufficient to separate installation faults from weather and building-envelope effects.
Installers pay for differentiation and fewer disputes.
A licensed partner will underwrite clearly bounded performance triggers after pilot evidence.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No unlicensed insurance risk-taking or access to household telemetry without explicit, revocable authorization.

concepts.title: Fleet Warranty Evidence Clearinghouse
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Use fleet-authorized connected-vehicle data to create neutral fault timelines that route repair work and resolve warranty responsibility for a per-case fee.
concepts.customer: Commercial fleets, leasing firms, and independent repair networks handling disputed or repeat vehicle faults
concepts.loss_event: A vehicle remains off-road or the fleet pays twice because manufacturer, workshop, and operator disagree on when a fault emerged and who must repair it.
concepts.payer: Fleet or leasing company per resolved case, with disclosed referral fees from repair providers
concepts.beneficiary: Fleet operator and whichever repair or warranty party is correctly responsible
concepts.authority_holder: Fleet or lessee controlling the connected vehicle and repair authorization
concepts.distributor: Fleet brokers, roadside-assistance firms, leasing managers, and independent workshops
concepts.risk_bearer: Repairer for workmanship, warrantor for covered faults, and fleet for uncovered operation
concepts.transaction_owner: A clearinghouse controlling consent, raw-data request, fault chronology, evidence handoff, and repair routing
concepts.first_paid_event: A fleet pays when a disputed case receives an accepted responsibility decision or competitively routed repair order.
concepts.acquisition_route: Start with one fleet, one recurring fault class, and one independent diagnostic specialist before adding brands.
concepts.compounding_asset: A cross-brand corpus linking raw events, fault claims, responsibility decisions, repairs, recurrence, and downtime
hypotheses: User-accessible raw vehicle data contains defensible event timing for selected fault classes.
Fleets will pay for faster resolution even when the decision is not in their favor.
Warrantors and workshops accept a neutral evidence format.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No access to driver-identifiable data beyond necessity, no tampering with vehicle systems, and no claim that the report legally binds a warrantor.
